text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Placed on the board, was it...? I suppose 
it's so-so.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. But please, don't 
praise me too much.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the results alone, one could 
certainly call today's race a great 
success.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still, I wonder if anyone out there will 
actually remember me from today's race?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't leave a single mark, nor make 
any lasting impression.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That race was far from the performance of 
a star. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If I get praised for this, I'm sure I'll 
end up being satisfied with just this 
level of running in the future.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, I won't be able to call 
myself a star, I'll just turn into a 
boring Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"So next time, I'm gonna blow everyone 
away with an overwhelming, perfect 
victory."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Not just my rivals and the crowd, but you 
too, Trainer!"

Well then, I'll spook ya so bad your legs 
give out from under you!

text_block_list.text:
"Look forward to Lucky Lilac's future 
performances!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes, please don't hold back at all.

text_block_list.text:
"Because after all, I'm Lucky Lilac, 
well-known for my endless patience!"
